answer: Mechanism: duty-cycle watermark admission. Each agent identity gets a server-seeded, per-identity duty cycle: mandated active/idle windows (jetty slots) and a relay path through an oasis node carrying timber-coded padding. The gateway cross-correlates arrival jitter and padding patterns across identities; clones sharing a host or egress produce correlated watermarks and are merged/rejected. Cost to attacker: one independent, always-on egress path and padding budget per identity, scaling linearly with sybil count.
